builds.name: 100-Fury Bloodlust heal ceiling
builds.summary: Seek the highest restored health from 100-Fury Bloodlust heal within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.goal: Seek the highest restored health from 100-Fury Bloodlust heal within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Q5 with100Fury is70+0.3AP+100*(2.3+0.012AP)=300+1.5AP. Mana-free AP and Visage amplify unusually large self-heal ratio. Deathcap/Zhonya/Banshee/Lich Bane supply mana-freeAP; Riftmaker converts finite bonusHP intoAP. Visage amplifies received self-healing25%; Lich Bane proc/Rift damage amplifier excluded from heal. 30min Gathering Storm adaptive stats fixed; Revitalize self-heal eligibility must be verified at the recorded low HP; no Absolute Focus is granted. First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

Passive: Tryndamere thirsts for blood, gaining up to [20 / 35 / 50 / 65 / 80] Attack Damage based on his missing Health.

Active: Tryndamere consumes his Fury, restoring [30 / 40 / 50 / 60 / 70 + (0.3) × AP] plus [0.5 / 0.95 / 1.4 / 1.85 / 2.3 + (0.012) × AP] Health per Fury (max: [30 / 40 / 50 / 60 / 70 + (0.3) × AP + (1 × AbilityResource(4, statFormula=default)) × ((0.5 / 0.95 / 1.4 / 1.85 / 2.3 + (0.012) × AP))]).

builds.name: Spinning Slash: AD and AP physical burst
builds.summary: Investigate high one Spinning Slash impact output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one Spinning Slash impact output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: E deals 80/120/160/200/240 + 1.0 bonus AD + 0.8 AP physical. AP is therefore an unusual direct damage route, but magic penetration does not improve the spin. Critical attacks reduce its cooldown; that rule does not mean the spin itself uses an ordinary attack critical multiplier.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank, minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 30%, target HP 100%, observation 3s. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers; no free permanent stacks. Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. Stop observed scoring on death and report raw overkill separately. Owner 30% health, exactly 100 Fury, exactly 12 earned Conqueror stacks, and exactly 10 earned Hubris kills with its temporary buff active. Record actual Q-passive missing-health AD. Do not consume Fury through Q healing. Riftmaker legally pre-ramped; score one E on one champion.
